description:
Windsor.ai TikTok Ads connects your TikTok Ads data to your AI assistant, so you can analyze performance and manage campaigns in plain English. Discover connected ad accounts, inspect valid fields and options, and query campaign, ad group, and ad metrics (spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, and conversions) over any date range. On confirmation, it can also pause or enable campaigns, ad groups, and ads and set campaign and ad group budgets.

Common workflows:
- Compare spend, clicks, and conversions by campaign for the last 30 days
- Find an underperforming ad group and pause it, after you confirm
- Adjust a campaign budget without leaving the conversation

Changes to your account are made only after you confirm the specific action; everything else is read-only. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.

defaultPrompt: Show me spend, impressions, clicks, and CPA by ad group for my Microsoft Ads account over the last 14 days.
My highest-CPA campaign is overspending — help me lower its daily budget.
Compare this week's Microsoft Ads spend and CPA to last week, then pause the worst-performing ad group.
